name: @mady/desktop
description: MadY — a modern scientific graphing and statistics application.
author: MadY

scripts.dist: electron-vite build && npm run manual && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: electron-vite build && npm run manual && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.dist:agent: set MADY_EDITION=agent&& electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml -c.productName="MadY Agent" -c.appId=com.mady.agent -c.nsis.shortcutName="MadY Agent"
scripts.dist:agent:dir: set MADY_EDITION=agent&& electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir -c.productName="MadY Agent" -c.appId=com.mady.agent
